scope.control_side: a67 parent only, selected by manifest bot order and preflight pinned paths
scope.analysis: existing extract only; no engine run, build, or extraction

source_certainty.native_round_gold: rounds.json.gz champions[].earned is populated from the engine snapshot's champion earnedGold field; the snapshot reader reads EXT_GOLD + champion id * 16; separate from soft event-derived earnings in meta.validation
source_certainty.first_treasure_completion: first end-of-round item snapshot with any Treasure Emblem (IDs 19, 21, 23)
source_certainty.post_completion: terminal native earned minus native earned at the end of first completion round; this excludes that entire round
source_certainty.categories: completed means an emblem appeared at any snapshot; partial means a Treasure shard appeared in any snapshot but no emblem ever appeared; no_treasure means neither appeared
source_certainty.limitations: native income and Treasure effects are observed after purchase; formula is a floor-counterfactual approximation on this fixed schedule, not causal ROI or proof of benefit. It ignores item costs and schedule/behavior changes. Gold values are integer snapshots, so estimates are approximate.

bonus_formula: 0.2 / (1 + base passive + 0.2) * post-completion native earned; base passive is 0.33 for Vesper Vale, 0 for other roles; Marcella's tribute-generated native income is eligible as specified
